description:
Get the current status and any active incidents for a status-page
    vendor. Use when the user asks 'is X down?' or 'is X having problems?'.

    slug: Provider slug or human name. Exact slug ('github',
    'amazon-web-services', 'google-cloud') is matched first; on miss
    we fall back to a search lookup so common shorthands ('aws',
    'gcp', 'github actions') and minor typos still resolve. The
    response includes `matched_via: 'fuzzy'` and the original query
    when the fuzzy fallback was used.

    The response has the service's Pingoru page (pingoru_url), the page
    where an email alert for it can be set up (alert_url, on the public
    endpoint, with a short note about it while an incident is open) and
    the vendor's own status page (status_url).
name: provider_status
title: Check a service's status
